scope: All 192 existing team archive entries screened; all 32 numerical/record differences reviewed.
ownerClarification: Adam confirms the four Summer 2013 games were never tracked. Permanent historical limitation, not a source-recovery task. Recorded-stat milestone dates remain in place.
coverageCaution: The other 160 entries match captured comparison values, not an independent completeness certification. In particular Summer 2013 PPG/SHG zeros and playoff PIM 8 reflect incomplete tracking.

entries.rationale: Legacy value equals recorded skater goals. Summer 2017 June 25 is 9 team goals versus 8 credited; Winter 2015/16 February 21 is 13 team goals versus 14 credited. The period scores corroborate the scoreboard, but no source identifies the player whose goal is missing or duplicated. Preserve individual stats; publish team and credited-player totals separately until a source correction is possible.

Owner confirms four games were never tracked; no further search for their player stats. Keep the original entry as a historical claim. Team scoreboard totals remain usable separately; do not convert missing player/penalty fields to verified zero. The June 9 regular-season game also has an existing 8-to-5 scoreboard/credited-goal mismatch; the four untracked games do not explain every 2013 discrepancy. The scoreboard total is 58; the recorded skater total is 49.0. These are different measures and cannot be equated.
